records.issue_text: No HTTP method check in app-credential.ts webhook; GET and other methods reach the credential-write path, should be restricted to POST
records.rationale: In `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the API route `handler` does not check `req.method` at all; it will attempt to `parse(req.body)` and then proceed to update/create credentials for any HTTP method as long as the header secret matches. This means non-POST methods (e.g., PUT/GET with a body) are not explicitly rejected, contrary to expected webhook behavior.

records.issue_text: `JSON.parse(symmetricDecrypt(...))` in app-credential.ts is unwrapped; wrong key or malformed ciphertext throws and yields a 500 with stack details instead of a 400
records.rationale: In `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the decrypted payload is processed as `JSON.parse(symmetricDecrypt(reqBody.keys, process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY || ""))` with no try/catch. If the encryption key is wrong/empty or ciphertext is malformed, `symmetricDecrypt` and/or `JSON.parse` can throw, causing an unhandled exception and a 500 response from the Next.js API route
